input_locked.zh-Hans: 键盘、鼠标点击与滚轮已锁定
input_locked.en: Keyboard, mouse buttons and scrolling are locked

release_inputs.zh-Hans: 请松开所有按键和鼠标按钮
release_inputs.en: Release all keys and mouse buttons to continue

filter_start_failed.en: Could not start the input filter

compiler_required.zh-Hans: 首次运行需要 Apple 命令行工具。请在终端运行 xcode-select --install，完成后重试。
compiler_required.en: First run requires Apple Command Line Tools. Run xcode-select --install in Terminal, finish installation, then try again.

build_failed.zh-Hans: 无法编译键鼠清洁辅助程序，输入未被锁定。
build_failed.en: Could not build the cleaning helper. Input has not been locked.

permission_required.zh-Hans: 请在系统设置的辅助功能中开启 NotchAny，然后再次点击键鼠清洁。
permission_required.en: Enable NotchAny in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility, then click Keyboard & Mouse Cleaning again.

probe_complete.zh-Hans: 权限检测完成，未锁定输入
probe_complete.en: Permission check complete; input was not locked

cleaning_started.en: Keyboard and mouse cleaning is on

cleaning_started_details.zh-Hans: 清洁后点击画面上的“结束清洁”。开启时闪烁红光，10 分钟后自动解除。
cleaning_started_details.en: Click Finish Cleaning when done. A red glow marks the start; input unlocks automatically after 10 minutes.

cleaning_finished_details.zh-Hans: 松开所有按键和鼠标按钮后恢复输入，并播放彩纸庆祝。
cleaning_finished_details.en: Release all keys and mouse buttons to restore input and play the confetti celebration.

self_test_complete.zh-Hans: 输入拦截自检通过，未锁定输入
self_test_complete.en: Input filtering checks passed; input was not locked
